title: Strong Drafts Need Compact Memories: Long-Context Speculative Decoding with Compressed KV Cache
abstract: arXiv:2608.30252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context LLM applications such as document summarization and multi-turn agents require generation from prefixes spanning tens of thousands of tokens, making decoding latency a major bottleneck. Speculative decoding (SD) reduces latency without changing model outputs, but its speedup depends on both accepted draft tokens and draft-step latency: Lightweight drafts are fast but lack the capacity to capture long-range dependencies, whereas strong independent drafts recover acceptance but incur growing KV-access cost at long prefixes. We introduce memory-augmented drafting for long-context SD, equipping a strong independent draft with compressed draft-side KV memory: A lightweight adaptor constructs and incrementally updates this memory to retain distant information and exact recent context. The target verifier retains its full KV cache and applies the standard accept/reject rule, preserving SD's lossless guarantee. Experiments on Llama~3

translated_title: 强草稿需要紧凑记忆：基于压缩KV缓存的长上下文投机解码
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.30252v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：诸如文档摘要和多轮智能体等长上下文大语言模型应用需要从跨越数万个token的前缀中进行生成，这使得解码延迟成为主要瓶颈。投机解码（SD）能够在不改变模型输出的情况下降低延迟，但其加速效果同时取决于被接受的草稿token数量和草稿步延迟：轻量级草稿速度快，但缺乏捕捉长程依赖关系的能力；而强大的独立草稿虽然能恢复接受率，却会在长前缀下产生不断增长的KV访问成本。我们为长上下文投机解码引入了记忆增强草稿机制，为强大的独立草稿配备压缩的草稿侧KV记忆：一个轻量级适配器负责构建并增量更新这一记忆，以保留远距离信息以及精确的近期上下文。目标验证器保留其完整的KV缓存，并应用标准的接受/拒绝规则，从而保持投机解码的无损保证。在Llama 3上的实验（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出面向长上下文投机解码的记忆增强草稿方法，通过轻量级适配器为强独立草稿构建并增量更新压缩的KV记忆，使其既能捕捉长程依赖又保持低草稿延迟，同时由保留完整KV缓存的目标模型验证，确保无损生成保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes memory-augmented drafting for long-context speculative decoding, where a lightweight adaptor builds and incrementally updates a compressed draft-side KV memory, enabling a strong independent draft to capture long-range dependencies with low latency while the target verifier retains its full KV cache to preserve the lossless guarantee.
